verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents experiments as the "immutable, comparable record of your eval runs" for tracking progress over time and catching regressions. Playgrounds let users compare results side by side across prompts and models, and evals can run in CI/CD on every pull request to catch regressions. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the experiment-to-experiment diff view (e.g. per-case regression highlighting and score deltas), independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison workflow.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Experiments are the immutable, comparable record of your eval runs. Run them from code or in the UI, track progress over time, and integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production.
Run full evaluations in real-time, compare results side-by-side, and share configurations with teammates.
